item.title: Amid legal battles, Suno says it will start watermarking songs
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Suno's watermarking feature comes as the company is fighting legal battles on several fronts.

item.title: Ford’s new electric truck, ‘Fathom’, starts at $28,350
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Due in "fall 2027," Ford said Thursday that it won't reveal what Fathom looks like until early next year.

item.title: Ex-Spotify employees raise $10M to bring the AI behind its recommendations to e-commerce
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: The startup's platform predicts what product a shopper wants next, learn their general taste, and fine-tune continuously based on what they do in real time.

item.title: Exclusive: Mirendil inks $100M+ Google Cloud deal to scale self-improving AI
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Mirendil has signed a $100 million-plus Google Cloud partnership to expand its compute infrastructure, powering research into self-improving AI systems designed to accelerate scientific discovery and AI development.

item.title: Google Maps adds agentic features, including food ordering and hotel bookings
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The launch of these new features reflects Google’s ambitions to transform Google Maps from a navigation tool into an assistant that's capable of helping users complete real-world tasks.

item.title: Omilia raises $67M to scale its customer support platform
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The Series B is the company's second fundraise since it last raised capital in 2020. In that time, it has increased its ARR by 10x to $60 million.

item.title: Get up to $400 off your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until Friday
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Starting today, you can take an additional $100 off your founder, investor, or attendee TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass, which is a nice bonus on top of our current discounted pricing.

item.title: Nikita Bier steps down as X’s head of product
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The serial entrepreneur is stepping down a little over a year after taking the "24/7 job" of overseeing X.

item.title: Travis Kalanick’s robotics startup Atoms taps former Uber finance chief as CFO
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Kalanick continues to get the band back together, after acquiring Anthony Levandowski's autonomy startup, and even soliciting investment from Uber.

item.title: Meta launches Muse Code, an AI agent for large code bases
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Meta expanded its AI coding offerings with a new agent that, it promises, can handle complex tasks with complex software.

item.title: Trump’s DOJ gains oversight of OpenAI’s green-card employee sponsorships
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The DOJ alleged that OpenAI did not meaningful attempt to hire U.S. citizens before seeking permanent residence for Visa-holding employees.

item.title: Moove raises $250M to become the backbone of the robotaxi industry
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Moove is scaling up the autonomous vehicle fleet management side of its business and plans to someday own, not just manage, Waymo robotaxis.

item.title: How Lightspeed found its newest hire … via Instagram DM
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Lightspeed partners Josh Machiz and Claire Zau stopped by the Equity studio to talk about the strategies behind their growing social media presence and their podcast, Lightwork.

item.title: Why Lightspeed is going all-in on creator-led venture capital
item.dc:creator: Theresa Loconsolo
item.description: Venture firms are turning to creators to build trust with the next generation of founders before a check is ever written. It’s a trend that’s been building with a16z’s acquisition of Erik Torenberg’s Turpentine podcast and OpenAI’s acquisition of TBPN. Lightspeed Venture Partners just made its own notable hire in that vein, bringing on Claire Zau, a seed investor with a major following on Instagram and […]

item.title: Klaviyo acquires Elias Torres’ Agency in full-circle reunion for tech founders
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The serial entrepreneur joins the e-commerce company as CPO to lead its AI agents.

item.title: Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The legendary Google executive is joined by other outgoing Google execs in a joint mission to use AI to push forward the process of scientific discovery.

item.title: Reddit aims to make ‘karma’ less important for first-time posters with shift to AI moderation tools
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Reddit is expanding its moderation tools and building stronger abuse prevention systems that it says could eventually reduce communities’ reliance on karma and account-age requirements, making it easier for legitimate newcomers to participate.

item.title: Lucid Motors just delayed its affordable EV. Now what?
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: The Cosmos EV is now slated for release in the second half of 2027. CEO Silvio Napoli said he's focused on getting the EV right, as well as its nearer-term robotaxi project with Uber and Nuro.

item.title: Meet the eight startups pitching at Startup Battlefield Australia
item.dc:creator: Isabelle Johannessen
item.description: The applications are in, and the TechCrunch Startup Battlefield team made their decisions!

item.title: PSA: Apple’s Private Relay can leak your real IP address
item.dc:creator: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
item.description: A bug in how Apple implements its Private Relay feature, which in theory masks users’ IP addresses from the sites they visit, can reveal users’ real IP addresses.
